description: An attribute other than params, variadic_param and result in a function block is an error
notes: The README only shows params, variadic_param and result in its examples, without saying whether anything else may be in a function block. hashicorp/hcl processes the block's body with Content and a schema of those three attributes (funcBodySchema in ext/userfunc/decode.go), so anything else is an error.
reference_error: An argument named "extra" is not expected here
